source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of regulating gene expression (PDF 140-142).

blocks.text: Kisi jandar ke saare genes aik hi waqt mein express nahin hote; mukhtalif genes mukhtalif waqt par express hote hain. Isi tarah har qisam ke cell mein aik hi genome (genes ka poora set) hota hai, lekin har cell mein saare genes ON nahin hote; har qisam ke cell mein khaas genes ON hote hain. Genes ko ON aur OFF karna aur un ke express hone ka waqt regulator proteins control karte hain, aur is amal ko gene expression ki regulation (control) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Jigar (liver) ke cells woh khaas genes express karte hain jo enzyme alcohol dehydrogenase banate hain. Yeh enzyme alcohol ko bezarar (non-toxic) molecules mein tor deta hai. Dimagh ke neurons mein bhi yeh genes hote hain, lekin woh unhein express nahin karte, yaani “OFF” rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Jism ke har cell mein wohi genes hain. Phir jigar ke cells neurons se mukhtalif kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Har qisam ke cell mein genes ka alag set ON hota hai. Maslan alcohol dehydrogenase ke genes jigar ke cells mein ON hain aur neurons mein OFF.

items: Sab cells mein aik hi genome; mukhtalif cells aur mukhtalif waqt mein mukhtalif genes ON.
Regulator proteins genes ko ON aur OFF karte hain.
